craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. How-question marks generic escape; whole-making questioned. Rejected: (a) answering → killed: v40 answers. Read aloud: WILL — HOW-could-IT-serve … TO-make-IT-whole.

lines: Will — how could it serve the purposes of every soul?
Give it to nature-in-general, for all, to make it whole?

reads_against.argmap: How could will serve all? → The how-question marks the generic-will escape, demolished in v40.
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn
